_docs: Product photo registry for GADGET GEEKS PRO. Maps phone models to REAL product photos — professional renders with GGP branding context. NO competitor branding (Device Plug, etc.). Rule 25 in operations-rulebook.json enforces this. Rule 26: ALL product data comes from gadgetgeekspro.myshopify.com Refresh theme ONLY.

photo_sources.shopify_cdn: Upload via image_gen.upload_to_shopify() for CDN URLs
photo_sources.shopify_store: gadgetgeekspro.myshopify.com — Refresh theme #157805740283 — THE ONLY DATA SOURCE
photo_sources.notes: All product photos are clean, professional renders with NO competitor branding. Desktop (16:9) and mobile (9:16) variants available. These are the ONLY phone images that should appear in final posts.

iphone_13.description: iPhone 13 bundle — phone with MagSafe case, screen protector, camera lens protector, charger + cable. Clean gradient background, premium product photography. Multiple color variants (Red, White, Teal, Pink) visible.

iphone_14.description: iPhone 14 bundle — phone (Starlight) with MagSafe case, screen protector, camera lens protector, charger + cable. Dark/black cinematic background with smoke/haze effect, reflective surface. Premium commercial look.

instructions_for_missing: For models without real product photos: (1) Pull product images from gadgetgeekspro.myshopify.com product pages. (2) Use Apple/Samsung official press renders. (3) Use AI for BACKGROUND ONLY — composite real product photo on top. (4) NEVER ask AI to generate the phone itself. (5) NEVER use images with competitor branding (Device Plug, Back Market, etc.).

image_pipeline_rules.product_hero_shots: MUST use real product photo from this registry. AI generates NOTHING for product hero.
image_pipeline_rules.lifestyle_composite: AI generates the SCENE (person, environment, lighting). Real product photo composited in via Canva/Pillow.
image_pipeline_rules.deal_urgency: MUST use real product photo. AI generates background gradient/lighting only if needed.
image_pipeline_rules.comparison: MUST use real product photos for both sides. AI generates NOTHING.
image_pipeline_rules.sustainability: AI generates the SCENE (hands, plants, desk). Real product photo composited in.
image_pipeline_rules.blog_headers: AI can generate full scene IF no phone is prominently featured. If phone is visible, use real photo composite.
image_pipeline_rules.branding: ALL images represent GADGET GEEKS PRO. Zero tolerance for competitor branding in any asset.
